summary:
# 今日社区动态（deepseek-flash | 2026-11-26 ~ 2026-11-28）

- 🔧 x86 以命名地址空间替代栈保护 cookie 的汇编 hack，简化 percpu 与 entry 路径（[Architecture](#subsystem-Architecture)）
- ⚡ kdump 回收未使用内存以缩小 vmcore 并缩短捕获时间（[Architecture](#subsystem-Architecture)）
- ⚡ 重构调度器响应时间管理，联动 PELT、schedutil 改善延迟敏感负载选核与调频（[Scheduling](#subsystem-Scheduling)）
- ⚡ rwsem 读者遇排队写者时不再抢锁续持，缓解写者饥饿、降低写侧延迟（[Core Kernel](#subsystem-Core%20Kernel)）
- ✨ KVM VMX 支持 secondary VM-exit controls，扩展 VMCS 字段与能力检测（[Virtualization](#subsystem-Virtualization)）
- ⚡ 换入脏 folio 时释放对应 swap slot，避免 swap 空间被无效占用（[Memory](#subsystem-Memory)）

## Drivers
- `perf` `other` `[other]` 发布 5.15.227-rc2 稳定版审查，汇总该分支跨子系统回移补丁。[↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261127052515.841545444@linuxfoundation.org/)
- `perf` `other` `[other]` 发布 5.10.276-rc2 稳定版审查，含 ACPI、libata、PM 等回移。[↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261127052100.671985356@linuxfoundation.org/)
- `perf` `other` `[other]` 发布 6.12.120-rc2 稳定版审查，覆盖 arm64 DTS 与多子系统修复。[↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261126105709.009001842@linuxfoundation.org/)
- `perf` `other` `[other]` 发布 6.18.66-rc2 稳定版审查，含 ublk、TLS、网络缓存行等文档与代码更新。[↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261126105725.767748294@linuxfoundation.org/)
- `perf` `other` `[other]` 发布 7.3.7-rc2 稳定版审查，含 arm64 GCS、overlayfs、电源管理等回移。[↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261126105729.110697432@linuxfoundation.org/)
- `bugfix` `[bugfix]` gpio 修复合集：cdev、OF 解析、多个控制器及用户态工具。[↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261127085000.18053-1-bartosz.golaszewski@oss.qualcomm.com/)
- `[feature]` gpiolib 在注销芯片前先释放其占用的线路，理顺所有者线在移除时的顺序。[↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261127-gpiolib-ownlines-v2-0-aambrozewicz@nvidia.com/)
- `[feature]` bcm2835 DMA 支持 BCM2711/2712 的 40 位寻址，配套更新 DTS 与 SPI/MMC/HDMI 使用者。[↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261127122236.4976-1-andrea.porta@suse.com/)
- `bugfix` `[bugfix]` 声音修复合集：OSS PCM、timer、HDA Realtek 与 FireWire 等。[↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/87y0aemhe6.wl-tiwai@suse.de/)
- `[feature]` gpiolib-shared 改为以 fwnode 为中心遍历共享线属性，去掉对 OF 专用接口的依赖。[↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261126-fwnode-for-each-prop-v4-0-d4b370ecfd52@oss.qualcomm.com/)
- 另有 54 项改动，详见：[↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261127-iio-core-attr-review-v2-0-e0aed1e8a81c@analog.com/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261126-drm-fops-show-fdinfo-v1-0-7cb1d1a5d6ef@chromium.org/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261126042835.436307-1-suraj.kandpal@intel.com/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261126071314.253890-1-wenst@chromium.org/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261126030526.3911143-1-yubowen8@huawei.com/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261127-regmap-atomic-shutdown-v1-1-1a0122144df6@collabora.com/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261126072220.4496-1-sreekuttan2156239@gmail.com/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261126093106.1345825-1-linmag7@gmail.com/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261127-i3c-master-of-populated-v2-1-c52095d00218@aspeedtech.com/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261126-alsa-timer-slave-flags-v2-1-8e07a536fea3@nitrohex.com/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261126065310.3451-1-sreekuttan2156239@gmail.com/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261126061910.2840-1-sreekuttan2156239@gmail.com/) 等 54 项

## Architecture
- `perf` `bugfix` kdump 回收未用内存以缩小 vmcore 并缩短捕获时间 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261127090723.741253-1-chenwandun1@gmail.com/)
- `perf` 统一各架构 set_memory/change_page_attr 实现为通用核心，消除重复代码并理顺页属性接口 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261126-generic-set-memory-v0-1-v2-0-723f1e33c3d8@kernel.org/)
- `bugfix` kexec 重构段加载流程并修复 CMA 重试失败，覆盖多个架构 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261127100925.3019877-1-ruanjinjie@huawei.com/)
- `perf` 新增 SoCFPGA FCS 随机数驱动，利用固件服务产生熵 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261127092808.15537-1-hang.suan.wang@altera.com/)
- `perf` `bugfix` USB anchor 协议修复三处 UAF 窗口，保护 URB 与 hcd 生命周期 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/179578612505.44635.14553263875690325600@kylinos.cn/)
- arm64 新增 CCA Realm Guest 证明 provider，通过 ACPI 暴露测量结果 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261127-arm_cca_mr-v3-0-df3230afce8f@arm.com/)
- `perf` 将 QCE 加密驱动拆分为 core 与 crypto 两部分，便于复用与解耦 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261127-qce-fix-self-tests-v13-1-80b601792901@oss.qualcomm.com/)
- PSCI 复位新增 reboot mode 驱动，支持厂商自定义重启模式 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261127-arm-psci-system_reset2-vendor-reboots-v28-0-da05a33b08d8@oss.qualcomm.com/)
- 新增 Qualcomm Molokai (SM8845) 与 Motorola Signature 支持 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261128-molokai-soc-v5-0-144801dfad7f@yahoo.com/)
- x86 以命名地址空间替代栈保护 cookie 的汇编 hack，简化 percpu 与 entry 路径 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261127142346.788995-4-ardb+git@google.com/)
- 另有 115 项改动，详见：[↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261127-sysreg-v4-0-a6318d18aab5@linux.ibm.com/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261126155339.1349218-1-arnd@kernel.org/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261127181958.113639-1-patrick.delaunay@foss.st.com/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/awmK6gaXd1EnO15l@kroah.com/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261127073231.1776847-1-alastair@d-silva.org/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261126-sm7250-v15-0-492014ec0a52@gmail.com/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261126-6768-init-v1-0-abc364a2447e@protonmail.com/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261126-jshekhar-v3-dcp-v3-0-f1e9d7505039@oss.qualcomm.com/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261127-meson-drm-create-hdmitx-phy-v5-0-88c43eb95468@aliel.fr/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261126-a733-cubie-a7s-dt-v6-0@gmail.com/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261126-wip-bhahn-imx95_upstreaming-v3-0-a2bda009bac8@phytec.de/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261126-dfi-clocks-and-rk3576-support-v3-0-0f33c1b8df48@collabora.com/) 等 115 项

## Observability
- `perf` arm64 增加 FUJITSU-MONAKA errata 规避，覆盖 barrier/cmpxchg/cpucaps 及 GICv3、arm_pmu，保障该 CPU 正确运行 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261127-monaka-fix-for-upstream-v4-0-3395c415bbe4@fujitsu.com/)
- `perf` rv 为 per-CPU 监视器加入逐边驻留时间统计，新增 edge_stat 接口与 selftest，便于分析状态机时序 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261127113609.650286-1-tobias.schaffner@siemens.com/)
- `perf` rv 新增 BPF 监视器支持，扩展 automata/da_monitor 并接入 sched 事件，可用 BPF 定义运行时验证自动机 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261126130004.127155-1-gmonaco@redhat.com/)
- `perf` 将 HMM 迁移基准从 selftests/mm 迁至 tools/mm，新增 hmm-bench 并复用公共头文件，便于独立运行性能测试 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261127014430.2043154-1-balbirs@nvidia.com/)
- `perf` `other` ring-buffer 大块分配改用 kvmalloc 变体，避免高阶原子分配失败并提升大缓冲区创建成功率 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261127151326.515232-1-vdonnefort@google.com/)
- `perf` `other` arm-spe 在合成样本时遵循 --time 范围，修正时间过滤对 SPE 数据不生效的问题 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261127123855.78212-1-jbernloehr@nvidia.com/)
- `perf` `other` jitdump 显式包含 linux/string.h，修复 strlcpy 声明缺失导致的构建失败 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261126-perf-string-h-v1-1-8f5c39ff30f0@arista.com/)
- ring-buffer 移除未使用的绝对时间戳模式，清理 ring_buffer 接口与文档，减少冗余代码 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261126213743.3044079-1-vdonnefort@google.com/)
- `bugfix` tracing/probes 修复探针执行与事件注销之间的竞态，防止释放后使用 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261126132830.14992-1-atenart@kernel.org/)
- tools/mm 新增 drgn 脚本展示 HugeTLB 预留信息，便于离线分析 hugetlb 池状态 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261126-hugetlb-resv-drgn-v1-1-345a6ee7c08c@gmail.com/)
- 另有 17 项改动，详见：[↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261126131318.470837-1-mahe.tardy@gmail.com/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261126011818.417-1-tongzhiwei@cmss.chinamobile.com/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261126154714.169698-1-leon.hwang@linux.dev/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261126153002.162337-1-leon.hwang@linux.dev/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261126162423.442922469@kernel.org/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/undine-1795651917544796669-555e1f2d7f002f30@undined.local/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261126081028.4208-1-zhaimingbing@cmss.chinamobile.com/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261126160122.35088-1-jahanzaibashraf1318@gmail.com/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261127184203.439481361@kernel.org/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261126215220.1205315-1-devnexen@gmail.com/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261126194347.42466-1-tphilipp@gmail.com/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261126011222.92180-1-dennylin0707@gmail.com/) 等 17 项

## Core Kernel
- bootconfig 支持 initrd 中多个具名配置并按需选择，扩展启动参数组织方式 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261127144614.61194-1-mhiramat@kernel.org/)
- `perf` printk：写入 /proc/sys/kernel/printk 时清除缓存的 console loglevel，避免后续改动被旧值掩盖 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261127071548.333115-1-xuanqiang.luo@linux.dev/)
- `perf` rwsem 读者在有排队写者时不再继续抢锁续持，缓解写者饥饿、降低写侧延迟 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261126-rwsem-dont-steal-from-queued-writer-v2-1-9772914de49e@kernel.org/)
- `perf` aux：可选的高阶分配改为不触发 reclaim，避免采样路径引发内存回收抖动 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261126-perf_aux_alloc_optimize_psi-v3-1-e06b921b276a@arm.com/)
- `perf` `other` livepatch 过渡期减少 tasklist_lock 争用，降低大任务量系统上的过渡开销 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261126072829.97792-1-laoar.shao@gmail.com/)
- workqueue 新增 WQ_PREFER_PERCPU，优先使用 per-CPU 池，减少跨 CPU 调度与锁竞争 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261126152458.742942-1-marco.crivellari@suse.com/)
- livepatch 过渡时保留正在退出的任务，避免其被漏掉而残留旧代码 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261126-klp-series-v3-v4-0-2ad73e9c9254@vt.edu/)
- signal 允许任务临时屏蔽 TIF_NOTIFY_SIGNAL，为稳定分支修复通知信号处理窗口 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/CAFaZ9ep26fhdkKcXZHOPSndkE9UV9x7k6GaX1Himi_+c28XLyA@mail.gmail.com/)
- signal 同上改动回移至 5.10.y，覆盖更早稳定内核的通知信号竞态 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/CAFaZ9eoNqw+mFPg2RXkP=gd=VPkHy3xxOFkj3Vc5iCpqSxwawg@mail.gmail.com/)
- `other` locktorture 清理阶段在 rcu_barrier 前加 synchronize_rcu，使回调清理顺序更可靠 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261126084249.17746-1-qiang.zhang@linux.dev/)
- 另有 8 项改动，详见：[↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261126-lklm-sysctl-ctx-flatarray-v1-0-d7fc9cc9b03e@kernel.org/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261127041853.127855-1-artem122novak@gmail.com/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261127-b4-coresight-cpu-debug-lockup-v1-0-69d3ad1e0fc8@iav.lv/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261127130850.3343364-1-elver@google.com/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261126214754.3630965-1-bradley.morgan@linux.dev/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/tencent_192A8A137B6CC69DDBF028C27205824BAC09@qq.com/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261126065958.89207-1-zhiqizhangg@gmail.com/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261127081001.327898-1-vedantdave354@gmail.com/)

## Virtualization
- KVM x86 引入 Hyper-V hypercall 退出处理与寄存器拦截，统一 emulate/hyperv 路径，提升嵌套与 SEV 场景兼容性 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261127152730.99319-1-dwmw2@infradead.org/)
- KVM VMX 支持 secondary VM-exit controls，扩展 VMCS 字段与能力检测，为新增退出原因提供控制位 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261126022743.4082392-1-sohil.mehta@intel.com/)
- KVM x86 新增 cmpxchg16b 指令模拟，配合 uaccess 辅助函数，支持 guest 在无硬件支持时执行该指令 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261126060515.2198-1-sarunkod@amd.com/)
- virtio 新增 Qualcomm DCP 传输包装层，含 DT binding、IPCC 通道与 virtio_mmio 扩展，接入新设备 ID [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261126-jshekhar-qcom-virtio-dcp-v1-0-7b49bda74916@oss.qualcomm.com/)
- `perf` `other` vsock/virtio 降低 RX 每包 socket 开销，调整 transport 公共层与 tracepoint，提升高吞吐小包场景性能 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261127062700.29387-1-physicalmtea@gmail.com/)
- `bugfix` KVM x86 LAPIC 修复 LVT0 屏蔽期间丢失 ExtINT 锁存的问题，附带 selftest 覆盖 PIC 模式 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/OS3PR01MB1025133EF63D307090C7718DEE7422@OS3PR01MB10251.jpnprd01.prod.outlook.com/)
- `other` vfio/fsl-mc 同样修正只读 region 可被写映射的问题，保持与 platform 版本一致的权限检查 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261126081644.45517-1-alexevgmart@gmail.com/)
- `bugfix` vfio/platform 阻止只读 region 映射被改为可写，修复 mmap 权限校验缺陷（5.10/5.15 稳定分支） [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261126081631.45468-1-alexevgmart@gmail.com/)

## Power Management
- `bugfix` regulator 核心修复锁顺序、越界读取、生命周期与全局状态问题，消除潜在 OOB 读与 UAF [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261127183624.3341010-1-lee@kernel.org/)
- regulator 与 auxdisplay 的 i2c_device_id 表改用指定初始化器，提升类型安全与可维护性 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/45e66776a1cb0fa54d1606b856887abe7e826ae6.1795776138.git.u.kleine-koenig@baylibre.com/)
- `bugfix` 随 7.4-rc5 拉取合入 thermal sysfs 修复，纠正热管理 sysfs 接口问题 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/CAJZ5v0goDeyB0c_g5YvKGGZZNKaSLqWKkei_9pb50BHseizSmw@mail.gmail.com/)
- `perf` cpufreq 核心在部分策略使能 boost 后保留全局 boost 状态，避免整体 boost 能力被意外关闭 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261126110903.3747240-1-jiangtianfeng@linux.alibaba.com/)
- 新增 X-Powers AXP318W PMIC 支持，扩展 axp20x MFD、regulator 驱动与 DT 绑定 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261127-axp318-regulator-v9-0-986b68f3c4a0@baylibre.com/)
- 另有 11 项改动，详见：[↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261127164044.285910-1-clamor95@gmail.com/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261126-netrani-pm6450-v1-v3-0-2343209bbf4c@krgm.moe/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261126-netrani-pm6450-v1-v2-0-2539a2422218@krgm.moe/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261127-ux500-epod-regulator-removal-v2-1-0ccab0f430fd@kernel.org/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261127-max77759-charger-fixes-v1-0-b364a0862d72@linaro.org/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/CA+m4KrDVNkHhqJhRVv7NRWhStNq8ZW+BfyAme6ZZrN-gqr9Q7g@mail.gmail.com/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261127124018.972-1-AeeSec@126.com/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261127074225.1798-1-zhaofeng2@cmss.chinamobile.com/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/CAJZ5v0jwg0cGJgPnP2SaXdcHWpW_5FPq25McuQmh9794L5QWpQ@mail.gmail.com/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261126005321.71799-1-iasnezhkov@gmail.com/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261127145216.2058830-1-ghidoliemanuele@gmail.com/)

## Scheduling
- `perf` powerpc 改用通用 cacheinfo，统一缓存拓扑与 CPU 热插拔路径，调度拓扑可直接复用。[↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261127152242.306333-1-sshegde@linux.ibm.com/)
- `perf` `other` 重构调度器响应时间管理，联动 PELT、schedutil 与 fair，改善延迟敏感负载的调频/选核决策。[↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261126051429.14091-1-qyousef@layalina.io/)
